User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious font. The specific flaw exists within the handling of Type 1 fonts in the Windows kernel. A crafted font can trigger kernel stack exhaustion. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service condition on machines running affected versions of Microsoft Windows.
